summary: Horizon Quantum Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a non-binding letter of intent, dated November 5, 2026, to acquire Singapore-based Entropica Labs Pte. Ltd., a private quantum software company focused on error correction and fault tolerance. Anticipated consideration is $27 million, payable in Horizon Quantum Class A ordinary shares; no per-share price or premium was disclosed. The deal remains subject to due diligence, related audits, execution of definitive agreements and customary conditions. No board recommendation, advisor or regulatory clock was named. Watch for definitive-agreement execution and share-issuance dilution, which drive the risk-arb read.
